# Asset Infinity

> Comprehensive asset management platform combining RFID, barcode, and QR code tracking with enterprise operations software for inventory, maintenance, and procurement.

Asset Infinity provides an integrated suite of asset management solutions including real-time tracking, CMMS maintenance scheduling, inventory management, and IT asset discovery. The platform supports multiple tracking technologies (RFID, barcode, QR, GPS, NFC) and offers add-on modules for specialized needs like capital project tracking, asset reservations, and facilities management.

## Key Topics

- RFID Asset Tracking
- Enterprise Asset Management
- Inventory Management
- Real-time Tracking
- Barcode & QR Code
- CMMS Software
- Work Order Management
- Asset Verification
- GPS Monitoring
- Procurement Management
- Helpdesk & Incident Management
- IT Asset Discovery
- Asset Reservation
- Maintenance Automation
- SLA Tracking

## Core Features

- [Enterprise Asset Management for Smarter Operations](https://www.assetinfinity.com/features/asset-management): Enterprise Asset Management solution for lifecycle and compliance
- [Inventory Management Software | Inventory Management System](https://www.assetinfinity.com/features/inventory-management-software): Inventory Management System with RFID, barcode, real-time tracking
- [CMMS Software | Maintenance Management System by Asset Infinity](https://www.assetinfinity.com/features/maintenance-schedule): CMMS software for maintenance scheduling and work order management
- [Procurement Management Software | Purchase Management Software](https://www.assetinfinity.com/features/procurement-management): Procurement and purchase management with budget and vendor tracking
- [Physical Asset Verification | Fixed Asset Auditing System](https://www.assetinfinity.com/features/asset-verification): Asset verification and auditing with QR/barcode compliance

## Tracking & Monitoring

- [RFID Asset Tracking Software | RFID Asset Management System](https://www.assetinfinity.com/solutions/rfid-asset-tracking): RFID asset tracking with real-time visibility and automated audits
- [GPS Asset Tracking Software | GPS Asset Tracker](https://www.assetinfinity.com/add-ons/gps-monitoring): GPS asset tracking with real-time location and geofencing
- [Real-time Inventory tracking with Asset Infinity's RFID Fixed Readers](https://www.assetinfinity.com/add-ons/inventory-rfid-reader): RFID fixed readers for real-time inventory and location tracking
- [Rfid Inventory Management and Tracking System by Asset Infinity](https://www.assetinfinity.com/add-ons/rfid-handheld-for-inventory): Handheld RFID readers for mobile inventory tracking and counting
- [Utility Management Software Solution | Utility Tracking Software](https://www.assetinfinity.com/features/usage-tracking): Utility tracking and management with cost forecasting and monitoring

## Service & Support Management

- [Help Desk Management Software | Incident Management Software](https://www.assetinfinity.com/features/helpdesk-breakdown): Helpdesk and incident management with SLA tracking and ticketing
- [Service Request Management Software by Asset infinity](https://www.assetinfinity.com/features/service-request): Service Request Management for asset tracking and automated routing

## Advanced Add-ons

- [Automate Discovery & Tracking with Agent-based IT Asset Discovery Tool](https://www.assetinfinity.com/add-ons/discovery-based-on-it-agents): Agent-based IT asset discovery and automated network scanning
- [Seamless Asset Request Management With Asset Infinity](https://www.assetinfinity.com/add-ons/asset-request): Asset request management with approval workflows and audit trails
- [Optimize Your Capital Work in Progress Management Solutions](https://www.assetinfinity.com/add-ons/cwip-capital-work-in-progress): CWIP capital project tracking with real-time expense monitoring
- [Integrated Facilities Management | Interactive Floor Plan](https://www.assetinfinity.com/add-ons/floor-plan): Interactive floor plan for facilities and asset management
- [Asset Reservation Software | Asset Booking System](https://www.assetinfinity.com/add-ons/asset-reservation): Asset reservation and booking system for resource scheduling
